title: State Snapshot
description: An immutable, versioned checkpoint of the company's canonical coordination state — canonical entity IDs and their evolving external system mappings. Snapshots make rollback to a known-good state a first-class runtime operation. The append-only audit log and typed-event ledger are never rewound; a rollback rolls history forward by emitting a coordination.state_rolled_back event.

contentHash.description: sha256 of the canonical-JSON snapshot content. Equal hashes captured identical state.

entities.description: Every canonical entity at snapshot time.

canonicalId.description: Permanent internal ID. Never changes for the lifetime of the entity.

l1Bucket.description: L1 universal lifecycle bucket on the canonical state ladder.

tombstonedAt.description: Set when soft-deleted. Records are never hard-deleted.

mergedInto.description: Canonical ID this entity was merged into. Merges are reversible pointers.

mappings.description: Every external-system mapping at snapshot time.

canonicalId.description: The canonical entity this mapping points at.

system.description: Canonical name of the external system, e.g. 'crm'.

externalId.description: The ID that external system assigned to the entity.

rotatedAt.description: Set when the external ID was rotated or superseded.
